title: Lahaina Residential condo rebuild grant
summary: At the May 1 meeting, a resident said all 60 units at Lahaina Residential were destroyed in the fire, and the board president put rebuild costs at about $35 million against $10 million in insurance, saying many owners cannot raise the rest. Bill 75 would grant $6 million to Hawaiʻi Community Lending for the rebuild. The budget director said the project cannot use federal disaster recovery funds unless it starts the process over.

timeline.text: The board president said many owners cannot come up with the money that will be required.
